apis.name: GlideRecord
apis.description: The primary class for database operations in ServiceNow. GlideRecord provides an object-oriented way to query, insert, update, and delete records without writing SQL. It supports complex queries with encoded query strings, join queries, aggregate-like patterns, and full CRUD lifecycle hooks via Business Rules.

methods.name: addQuery
methods.description: Adds a filter to the query. Can take two or three arguments (field, value) or (field, operator, value).

methods.name: addEncodedQuery
methods.description: Adds a filter using a ServiceNow encoded query string (the string found in a breadcrumb).

methods.name: addOrCondition
methods.description: Adds an OR condition to the previous query filter.

methods.name: addJoinQuery
methods.description: Adds a join query to another table.

methods.name: addNullQuery
methods.description: Adds a query for fields that are null (empty).

methods.name: addNotNullQuery
methods.description: Adds a query for fields that are NOT null.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a single record by sys_id or by a field/value pair. Returns true if found.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes the query against the database.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Moves to the next record in the result set. Returns true if another record exists.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new record into the database.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the current record in the database.

methods.name: deleteRecord
methods.description: Deletes the current record.

methods.name: deleteMultiple
methods.description: Deletes ALL records matching the current query. WARNING: Cannot be undone, does not trigger per-record business rules. Always verify your query with getRowCount() before calling.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Creates an empty record and sets default values.

methods.name: newRecord
methods.description: Creates a new record, sets default values, and assigns a new sys_id immediately.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Gets the string value of a field.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value of a field.

methods.name: getDisplayValue
methods.description: Gets the user-friendly display value of a field (e.g., name instead of sys_id for references).

methods.name: getRowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of records returned by the query.

methods.name: setLimit
methods.description: Limits the number of records returned by the query.

methods.name: orderBy
methods.description: Orders the results by the specified field in ascending order.

methods.name: orderByDesc
methods.description: Orders the results by the specified field in descending order.

methods.name: canWrite
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to write to this record/table.

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to read this record/table.

methods.name: setWorkflow
methods.description: Enables or disables the running of business rules, workflows, and engines for this operation.

methods.name: autoSysFields
methods.description: Enables or disables the automatic updating of system fields (sys_updated_by, sys_updated_on, etc.).

methods.name: getUniqueValue
methods.description: Returns the sys_id of the current record.

methods.name: getTableName
methods.description: Returns the name of the table.

methods.name: isValidField
methods.description: Checks if the specified field exists in the table.

methods.name: getLink
methods.description: Returns a URL to the current record.

methods.name: hasNext
methods.description: Determines if there are any more records in the GlideRecord object.

methods.name: addActiveQuery
methods.description: Adds a query to filter only active records.

methods.name: doit
methods.description: Function defined in GlideRecord.js
methods.example: /* No code sample available for this method */

methods.name: getEncodedQuery
methods.description: Returns the encoded query string for the current GlideRecord query. Useful for debugging or passing queries between components.

methods.name: getElement
methods.description: Returns the GlideElement for the specified field. Provides access to field-level methods like getDisplayValue(), getReferenceTable(), and changes().

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Returns true if the GlideRecord object is valid and the table exists.

methods.name: isValidRecord
methods.description: Returns true if the current record is valid (has been loaded with data via get/next).

methods.name: changes
methods.description: Returns true if any field on the record has been modified. Commonly used in Business Rules.

methods.name: isNewRecord
methods.description: Returns true if the record has never been inserted into the database.

methods.name: getRecordClassName
methods.description: Returns the actual table name of the record. Critical for extended tables (e.g., an incident record on the task table).

methods.name: setAbortAction
methods.description: Aborts the current database operation. Used in Business Rules to prevent insert/update/delete.

methods.name: chooseWindow
methods.description: Sets a range of records to return, enabling pagination. Parameters are firstRow and lastRow (zero-indexed).

methods.name: getLastErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns the last error message from a failed insert, update, or delete operation.

methods.name: setCategory
methods.description: Sets a category for the query, which can be used in Business Rules to determine query origin and improve performance.

methods.name: operation
methods.description: Returns the current database operation: insert, update, or delete. Used in Business Rules.

apis.name: GlideSystem (gs)
apis.description: The GlideSystem API provides a number of system methods that provide information about the system or currently logged in user.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Logs an informational message to the system log. Supports message formatting.

methods.name: warn

methods.name: error
methods.description: Logs an error message to the system log.

methods.name: debug

methods.name: addInfoMessage
methods.description: Adds an informational message to the top of the screen for the user.

methods.name: addErrorMessage
methods.description: Adds an error message to the top of the screen for the user.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Gets a value from the System Properties (sys_properties) table.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Sets a system property value.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Returns a reference to the GlideUser object for the current user.

methods.name: getUserID
methods.description: Returns the sys_id of the current user.

methods.name: getUserName
methods.description: Returns the username (user_name) of the current user.

methods.name: hasRole
methods.description: Checks if the current user has a specific role.

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Returns a reference to the GlideSession object.

methods.name: nowDateTime
methods.description: Returns the current date and time in the user's display format.

methods.name: beginningOfLastMonth
methods.description: Returns the date and time for the beginning of last month.

methods.name: eventQueue
methods.description: Queues an event for the event manager.

methods.name: isInteractive
methods.description: Checks if the current session is interactive (user-driven) or background (e.g., job).

methods.name: isLoggedIn
methods.description: Checks if a user is logged in.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Retrieves a translated message from the UI Messages table.

methods.name: tableExists
methods.description: Checks if a table exists in the database.

methods.name: nil
methods.description: Checks if a value is null, empty string, or undefined.

methods.name: eventQueueScheduled
methods.description: Queues an event to run at a specific time.

methods.name: getUserDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the current user.
methods.example:
var displayName = gs.getUserDisplayName();
gs.info('Current user: ' + displayName);

apis.name: GlideForm (g_form)
apis.description: Client-side API for manipulating the current form. Accessible via the global g_form variable in Client Scripts, UI Policies, and UI Actions (client-side). Provides methods for getting/setting field values, controlling visibility, mandatory state, decorations, and form-level messages.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Gets the value of a field on the form.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value of a field on the form. For reference fields, can take (field, sys_id, displayValue).

methods.name: clearValue
methods.description: Clears the value of a field.

methods.name: setReadOnly
methods.description: Sets a field to read-only or editable.

methods.name: setMandatory
methods.description: Sets a field as mandatory or not.

methods.name: setDisplay
methods.description: Shows or hides a field and its container/label (reclaims space).

methods.name: setVisible
methods.description: Shows or hides a field but keeps the space reserved.

methods.name: addInfoMessage
methods.description: Displays an info message at the top of the form.

methods.name: addErrorMessage
methods.description: Displays an error message at the top of the form.

methods.name: showFieldMsg
methods.description: Displays a message directly under a specific field.

methods.name: clearMessages
methods.description: Removes all info/error messages from the top of the form.

methods.name: hideFieldMsg
methods.description: Hides field messages for a specific field.

methods.name: addOption
methods.description: Adds a choice to a choice list field.

methods.name: removeOption
methods.description: Removes a choice from a choice list field.

methods.name: clearOptions
methods.description: Removes all choices from a choice list.

methods.name: getTableName
methods.description: Returns the table name of the current record.

methods.name: getUniqueValue
methods.description: Returns the sys_id of the current record.

methods.name: isNewRecord
methods.description: Returns true if the record has not been saved yet.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the record (equivalent to clicking Save).

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Submits the record (equivalent to clicking Submit/Update).

methods.name: flash
methods.description: Flashes the field label to draw attention.

methods.name: getReference
methods.description: Retrieves the GlideRecord of a reference field. Note: Use callback for best performance.

methods.name: getSections
methods.description: Returns an array of form sections.

methods.name: setSectionDisplay
methods.description: Shows or hides a form section.

methods.name: isMandatory
methods.description: Checks if a field is mandatory.

methods.name: hasField
methods.description: Checks if a field exists on the form.

methods.name: getControl
methods.description: Gets the HTML element for a field.

methods.name: getOption
methods.description: Gets the HTML element for a specific option.

methods.name: showRelatedList
methods.description: Shows a related list.

methods.name: hideRelatedList
methods.description: Hides a related list.

methods.name: getRelatedListNames
methods.description: Gets the names of all related lists on the form.

methods.name: setDisabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a field (prevents user input). Alias for setReadOnly in newer versions.

methods.name: setLabel
methods.description: Changes the label displayed for a field on the form.

methods.name: getLabelOf
methods.description: Returns the current label text of a field.
methods.example:
var label = g_form.getLabelOf('assigned_to');
console.log('Current label: ' + label);

methods.name: getBooleanValue
methods.description: Returns a boolean value from a checkbox or boolean field (handles string 'true'/'false' conversion).

methods.name: getIntValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value of a field.

methods.name: addDecoration
methods.description: Adds a small icon next to the field label for visual indicators. Icons use the ServiceNow icon font.

methods.name: removeDecoration
methods.description: Removes an icon previously added with addDecoration.

methods.name: hideRelatedLists
methods.description: Hides all related lists on the form.
methods.example:
// Hide all related lists for a cleaner form
g_form.hideRelatedLists();

methods.name: showRelatedLists
methods.description: Shows all related lists on the form.

apis.name: GlideUser (g_user)

methods.name: getFullName

methods.name: hasRole

methods.name: hasRoleExactly

methods.name: hasRoles

properties.name: userName

properties.name: userID

properties.name: firstName

properties.name: lastName
properties.description: The last name of the current user.

methods.name: addParam

methods.name: getXML

methods.name: getXMLAnswer

apis.name: GlideElement
apis.description: Represents a single field (column) on a GlideRecord. Every field accessed on a GlideRecord (e.g., gr.short_description) returns a GlideElement, not a raw value. GlideElement provides methods for type checking, display values, change detection, and reference field navigation.

methods.name: getJournalEntry
methods.description: Returns journal field entries (work_notes, comments, etc.) as a formatted string. Pass -1 to get all entries, or a positive number to limit.

methods.name: nil
methods.description: Checks if the field value is null or empty.

methods.name: canWrite
methods.description: Checks if the current user can write to this field.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts the GlideElement value to a JavaScript string. Implicitly called in string concatenation, but explicit use is recommended for clarity.

methods.name: getDisplayValue
methods.description: Returns the display value of the field. For reference fields, returns the display value of the referenced record instead of a sys_id.

methods.name: getReferenceTable
methods.description: Returns the name of the table referenced by a reference field.

methods.name: getRefRecord
methods.description: Returns a GlideRecord object for the record referenced by a reference field. The record is automatically loaded.

methods.name: getED
methods.description: Returns the Element Descriptor (GlideElementDescriptor), providing metadata about the field such as type, length, and attributes.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Returns the value of a dictionary attribute for the field.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the human-readable label of the field from the dictionary.

methods.name: getTableName
methods.description: Returns the name of the table that contains this field.

methods.name: changes
methods.description: Returns true if the field value has changed in the current transaction. Used in Business Rules.

methods.name: changesFrom
methods.description: Returns true if the field was changed FROM the specified value.

methods.name: changesTo
methods.description: Returns true if the field was changed TO the specified value.

apis.name: GlideAggregate
apis.description: Extension of GlideRecord designed for database aggregation operations (COUNT, SUM, MIN, MAX, AVG) without loading individual records. Significantly more performant than iterating GlideRecord for counting or statistical queries.

methods.name: addAggregate
methods.description: Adds an aggregation operation.

methods.name: getAggregate
methods.description: Retrieves the result of the aggregation.

methods.name: setGroup
methods.description: Determines whether to group the results by the fields used in orderBy.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Moves to the next aggregate record.

methods.name: groupBy
methods.description: Groups the aggregate results by the specified field, similar to SQL GROUP BY.

methods.name: orderByAggregate
methods.description: Orders the results by an aggregate value.

methods.name: addEncodedQuery
methods.description: Adds an encoded query to the aggregate.

methods.name: addQuery
methods.description: Adds a query filter to the aggregate.

apis.name: GlideDateTime
apis.description: Server-side date/time manipulation class. Handles timezone conversions, date arithmetic, formatting, and comparisons. All internal storage is in UTC; display values are converted to the user's timezone. Replaces raw JavaScript Date objects for ServiceNow development.

methods.name: Constructor
methods.description: Creates a GlideDateTime object for the current time or a specified time.
methods.example:
var gdt = new GlideDateTime(); // now
var gdt2 = new GlideDateTime('2023-01-01 12:00:00');

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Gets the internal value in UTC format.

methods.name: getDisplayValue
methods.description: Gets the date/time in the current user's format and timezone.

methods.name: addDaysUTC
methods.description: Adds a number of days to the UTC time.

methods.name: addWeeksLocalTime
methods.description: Adds a number of weeks based on local time.

methods.name: getNumericValue
methods.description: Returns the date/time in milliseconds since epoch.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares two GlideDateTime objects. Returns 0 if equal, 1 if current is greater, -1 if current is smaller.

methods.name: subtract
methods.description: Subtracts one GlideDateTime from another and returns a GlideDuration.

methods.name: getDayOfWeekLocalTime
methods.description: Returns the day of the week (1=Monday, 7=Sunday) in local time.
methods.example:
var gdt = new GlideDateTime();
var day = gdt.getDayOfWeekLocalTime();

methods.name: getInternalMidnight
methods.description: Returns midnight of the specified day of the week.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the date/time value using an internal format string (UTC).

methods.name: setDisplayValue
methods.description: Sets the date/time using the user's display format and timezone. The value is automatically converted to UTC internally.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds the specified number of milliseconds to the date/time.

methods.name: addSeconds
methods.description: Adds the specified number of seconds.

methods.name: addDaysLocalTime
methods.description: Adds days based on the user's local timezone.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Returns true if this GlideDateTime is after the specified GlideDateTime.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Returns true if this GlideDateTime is before the specified GlideDateTime.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the date portion as a GlideDate object (no time component).

methods.name: getTime
methods.description: Returns the time portion as a GlideTime object (no date component).

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Returns true if the GlideDateTime contains a valid date/time value.

methods.name: setHttpMethod

methods.name: setBasicAuth

methods.name: saveResponseBodyAsAttachment

methods.name: executeAsync
methods.description: Executes the REST message asynchronously via ECC queue.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code from the response.

methods.name: setMIDServer

methods.name: setStringParameter

methods.name: setAuthenticationProfile

methods.name: setQueryParameter

methods.name: getResponseBody
methods.description: Returns the response body as a string (called on RESTResponseV2).

methods.name: setEccParameter

methods.name: setSubject

methods.name: setBody

methods.name: save
methods.description: Sends the email.

methods.name: setFrom
methods.description: Sets the sender email address.

methods.name: setReplyTo
methods.description: Sets the reply-to email address.

methods.name: selectOne

methods.name: forEach

methods.name: toArray

methods.name: insert

methods.name: update

methods.name: updateMultiple

methods.name: disableWorkflow

apis.name: Client-side Global Functions

apis.name: ArrayUtil

methods.name: intersect
methods.description: Returns elements present in both arrays.

methods.name: concat
methods.description: Concatenates two arrays.

methods.name: addInfoMessage
methods.description: Displays an informational message in the portal.

methods.name: addErrorMessage

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches a widget model.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Triggers the widget server script to re-execute and refreshes the widget with updated data.

methods.name: addTrivialMessage

methods.description: Generates a SHA256 hex digest from a string.

apis.name: RESTAPIResponse
apis.description: Builds the HTTP response for a Scripted REST API endpoint. Use in the script of a Scripted REST Resource to set status codes, headers, and body content.

methods.name: setBody
methods.description: Sets the body content to send in the web service response.

methods.name: setContentType
methods.description: Assigns a value to the Content-Type header.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status code number for the web service response.

methods.name: setHeader
methods.description: Sets a custom response header.

methods.name: setError
methods.description: Sets an error on the response with a standardized error object.

methods.name: getStreamWriter
methods.description: Returns a stream writer for streaming large response bodies.

apis.name: RESTAPIRequest
apis.description: Provides access to the HTTP request details in a Scripted REST API resource script. Contains the request body, headers, path parameters, and query parameters.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Returns the value of a specific header.
methods.example:
var contentType = request.getHeader('Content-Type');
var authToken = request.getHeader('Authorization');

methods.name: body (property)
methods.description: The request body object. Access body.data for the parsed JSON object, or body.dataString for the raw string.

methods.name: pathParams (property)
methods.description: Object containing URL path parameters defined in the resource path (e.g., /{tableName}/{sys_id}).

methods.name: queryParams (property)
methods.description: Object containing URL query string parameters. Each value is an array (supports multiple values per key).

methods.name: getRequestedURI
methods.description: Returns the full URI of the request.
methods.example:
var uri = request.getRequestedURI();
gs.info('Request URI: ' + uri);

methods.name: mapUrlToSPUrl

apis.name: GlideRecordSecure

apis.name: GlideDuration
apis.description: Represents a span of time (days, hours, minutes, seconds). Returned by GlideDateTime.subtract() and used for duration fields.

methods.name: Constructor
methods.description: Creates a GlideDuration. Pass milliseconds or a duration string.
methods.example:
var dur = new GlideDuration('3 12:00:00'); // 3 days 12 hours
var dur2 = new GlideDuration(86400000); // 1 day in ms

methods.name: getDayPart
methods.description: Returns the number of days.
methods.example:
var diff = GlideDateTime.subtract(start, end);
gs.info('Days: ' + diff.getDayPart());

methods.name: getRoundedDayPart
methods.description: Returns the rounded number of days.

methods.name: getDisplayValue
methods.description: Returns the duration as a formatted string.

methods.name: getDurationValue
methods.description: Returns the duration in d HH:mm:ss format.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds another GlideDuration to this one.

methods.name: getByFormat
methods.description: Returns the duration in the specified format.

apis.name: GlideSchedule
apis.description: Works with schedules defined in the cmn_schedule table. Used to calculate business duration, check if a time is within a schedule, and determine schedule-aware deadlines.

methods.name: Constructor
methods.description: Loads a schedule by sys_id.

methods.name: isInSchedule
methods.description: Returns true if the specified GlideDateTime falls within the schedule.

methods.name: duration
methods.description: Returns the duration of time within the schedule between two dates.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the schedule. Called automatically by the constructor.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the schedule.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Returns true if the schedule was loaded successfully.
